purpose: Multiple amendments to related definitions in one instrument (CSSLR, CTLR, Indebtedness) plus ratio schedule restatement; also tests missing-parent fail-closed when Seventh A&R is absent.
expectedFailClosedBehavior: Without Seventh A&R in package, targetResolutionStatus for definition targets must not claim UNIQUE against Eighth A&R; out-of-package parent must remain unresolved. Independent verification must not confirm RESOLVED effects against the wrong base document.

sourcePointers.quote: The definition of "Consolidated Senior Secured Leverage Ratio" is hereby amended by deleting the reference therein to "$75,000,000" and substituting in lieu thereof the dollar amount "$100,000,000".
Eighth A&R Closing Date June 10, 2025 — distinct instrument vintage from Seventh A&R parent of Second Amendment
